column1: # THE TARGET CLADE TABLE: the ONE thing needed to say whether an off target
# amplicon came from INSIDE the target or from OUTSIDE it.
# WHY IT EXISTS (2026-08-07): MFEprimer's "off target" measure rests ON LENGTH
# ALONE. Of the 1,550 differently sized amplicons a universal bacterial primer
# found, 1,519 begin with "Bacteria;..." in SILVA, that is they are INSIDE the
# target and are the natural length polymorphism of 16S. Put into the verdict,
# the raw count made that pair come out risky. This table makes the distinction
#   hedef   the target name exactly as it stands in the panel and the order list
#   alan    Bacteria | Archaea | Eukaryota, the FIRST token of the SILVA string.
#           Class (b) is the same domain outside the clade; (c) is a different
#   klad    a comma separated token list. When ONE OF THESE occurs in the
#           amplicon's taxonomy string, the amplicon counts as INSIDE the target.
#   kaynak  WHERE those tokens came from, so the table can be audited
